description:
Use this when the user wants a price to ship a car or other vehicle inside the United States, and they mention a car, SUV, truck, van, motorcycle, or a year, make, and model.

Do not use for a household move, a long-distance move, or an international move. Do not use when the user only talks about a house, apartment, bedrooms, furniture, or boxes. Long-distance and international moves are Cross Country Movers services: use `get_long_distance_quote` or `get_international_quote`. Do not call this tool together with those tools unless the user also asks to ship a vehicle. Do not use for boats, RVs, or shipping a vehicle to or from another country.

Input examples:

- pickup: Phoenix, AZ. delivery: Newark, NJ. year: 2022. make: Toyota. model: RAV4.
- pickup: Los Angeles, CA. delivery: Miami, FL. year: 2021. make: Tesla. model: Model 3. transport: enclosed.
name: get_quote
title: Get car shipping quote
